name: Litmus
long_description:
At Litmus, we’re building evals for humans and redefining how talent is evaluated. Teams like Mercor, Wispr, Composio, Neo Scholars, Astranis, and more are already using Litmus to build their technical teams.

Every company in the world will soon be powered by neo-humans (agent assisted people). But building evals to measure neo-human performance is unexplored and difficult. It requires systematically benchmarking neo-human capabilities and failure modes across all sectors of knowledge work, developing reproducible environments that test neo-human performance on complex tasks, and designing causal attribution frameworks over execution trajectories to identify and validate reproducible action sequences and decision patterns that lead to successful outcomes.

At Litmus, we’re solving this problem. We deliver hiring insights to companies by capturing how candidates use tools, reason, and make decisions in their interviews, giving agentic graders the evidence to evaluate candidate skillset and predict job performance.

launches.title: Litmus - The industry's most accurate engineering interview
launches.tagline: Scalable, async work trials built from your repos, tickets, and JDs
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** We evaluate candidates through async technical assessments built from your own context (repos, tickets, and job descriptions) and let them work in their own setup with all their tools while we track and evaluate their process and output. _Engineering is changing; we help you hire for the role it’s becoming. Learn more at [litmushiring.com](http://litmushiring.com)._

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lusUktcmZGA>

**The problem**\
You're a month in with a new hire and they're just not getting it: struggling to ship independently, shipping AI-generated code they can't explain, clueless when production breaks. None of this showed up in your interview because your interview was never designed to catch it.

We all already agree LeetCode sucks. But work trials are time-draining, unscalable, and kind of awkward when you know within the first hour someone's not gonna make it. So most teams are stuck choosing between a broken screen and a process that doesn't scale.

**What we built**\
Litmus fixes both. We turn your repos, tickets, and job descriptions into a full interview pipeline where every assessment is generated from scratch for your company. Not a generic template, your actual codebase, your real engineering problems, scoped as end-to-end features.

Candidates work in their own setup, with all their tools including AI because that's how engineering works now, and that's what you're hiring for. 

Every submission runs in a sandbox, so graders evaluate real code execution, not what looks good on paper, and grading is tuned to your company across tool fluency, process, and outcome. 

The result: a real read on how someone actually builds, not just how they interview.

**Traction**\
**3,000+ assessments evaluated**. **$60k ARR**, growing fast. We've built the hiring system for **Neo Scholars**, their portfolio, and others. Let us bring our expertise to your team.

**Who we are**\
We're Shaivi and Elena. As a SWE at Two Sigma and Meta, Elena watched people ace every interview and then fail to build anything real on the job. Shaivi worked at early-stage startups and in VC, sitting beside founders as they agonized over which engineers to trust with the product. Two sides of the same coin - the most important decision a company makes is its team, and current interviews still can't tell you who'll deliver. Litmus does.

**Our ask**\
**Scaling your eng team?** **We'll come to your office, set you up, and run Litmus on your next role. Book a demo at [litmushiring.com](http://litmushiring.com).** And if you know a team drowning in engineering interviews, send them our way.
